data.gender_notes: Nikku is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Niketanam’, which means ‘place of victory’. In Hindu mythology, Nikku is a name associated with gods and warriors. It is believed that the name instills courage, strength, and determination. The name Nikku carries the meaning “Victorious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nikku usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name imbued with the spirit of victory and courage.
data.etymology: Nikku belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nikku total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
